_comment: AI 编年史与版图（v7 S39 · 2026-10-19）。真相源：本文件 → build.mjs 渲染 learn.specul/atlas/。每条 ref 都是三段式 [中文标签, URL, 英文标签]，URL 逐个实测过（arXiv 核 <title>；官方博客 403 反爬按 blocked 口径）。改这里，不要改产物页。

lead.zh: 刚接触 AI，先弄清「谁是谁、谁先谁后」。这一页有三栏：关键模型时间线、公司版图、术语演变。每条都带官方出处。
lead.en: Getting into AI starts with who's who and what came first. Three columns here: a timeline of key models, a company map, and how the vocabulary changed. Every entry carries an official source.

note.zh: 《Attention Is All You Need》发表。今天所有主流大模型都建立在这个架构上。
note.en: "Attention Is All You Need" is published. Every mainstream large model today builds on this architecture.

note.zh: OpenAI 证明「先预训练、再微调」这条路在语言模型上走得通。
note.en: OpenAI shows that pre-training then fine-tuning works for language models.

ref: GPT-1 论文（OpenAI 官方 PDF）
Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training (OpenAI official PDF)

note.zh: 双向编码器成为那一时期的标准预训练做法。
note.en: Bidirectional encoding becomes the standard pre-training recipe of that period.

note.zh: OpenAI 公开演示：模型规模一大，通用能力就出现。
note.en: OpenAI demonstrates publicly: scale up the model, general ability appears.

ref: GPT-2 论文（OpenAI 官方 PDF）
Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (OpenAI official PDF)

note.zh: 少样本学习：不训练，在提示里给几个例子就能用。
note.en: Few-shot learning: no training, just a few examples in the prompt.

note.zh: 在代码上训练的模型会写代码，「AI 写程序」这条路从此打开。
note.en: Models trained on code write code; the AI-coding path opens here.

ref: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code (arXiv 2107.03374)

note.zh: 用人类反馈微调（RLHF），模型开始听话、按指令办事。
note.en: Fine-tuning with human feedback (RLHF): models start following instructions.

ref: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155)

note.zh: 对话式 AI 进入公众视野，「AI」一词开始默认指聊天机器人。
note.en: Conversational AI reaches the public; "AI" starts defaulting to chatbots.

note.zh: Meta 放出开放权重模型，衍生出一大批社区模型。
note.en: Meta releases open-weight models; a large family of community derivatives follows.

ref: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models (arXiv 2302.13971)

note.zh: Anthropic 的对话模型公开，主打安全对齐。
note.en: Anthropic's conversational model goes public, with safety alignment front and center.

note.zh: 多模态输入、更强的推理，官方技术报告同步发布。
note.en: Multimodal input and stronger reasoning, published with an official technical report.

note.zh: Meta 放出可商用的开放权重模型。
note.en: Meta releases an open-weight model that permits commercial use.

ref: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models (arXiv 2307.09288)

note.zh: 小模型打出比更大模型更好的成绩，开放权重。
note.en: A small model beats larger ones on benchmarks, open-weight.

note.zh: Google 把 DeepMind 与 Brain 合并后推出的多模态模型家族。
note.en: Google's multimodal model family, launched after DeepMind and Brain merged.

ref: Gemini 1 技术报告（DeepMind 官方 PDF）

note.zh: 三档产品线，最高档追平当时最强的闭源模型。
note.en: A three-tier product line; the top tier matches the strongest closed models of the time.

note.zh: Meta 的开放权重家族，技术报告同年 7 月发布。
note.en: Meta's open-weight family; its technical report follows in July.

note.zh: 中国团队的开放权重模型，成绩逼近顶级闭源模型。
note.en: A Chinese team's open-weight model approaching top closed models on benchmarks.

note.zh: 用强化学习训练推理能力，方法开源。
note.en: Reasoning ability trained via reinforcement learning, with the method open-sourced.

ref: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning (arXiv 2501.12948)

orgs.name: OpenAI
orgs.zh: ChatGPT 与 GPT 系列的制造者，影响力最大的闭源实验室。
orgs.en: Maker of ChatGPT and the GPT series; the most influential closed lab.

orgs.name: Anthropic
orgs.zh: Claude 系列的制造者，把安全对齐放在产品叙事最前面。
orgs.en: Maker of the Claude series; safety alignment leads its product story.

orgs.name: Google DeepMind
orgs.zh: AlphaGo 的出身，2023 年与 Google Brain 合并，现产出 Gemini。
orgs.en: Origin of AlphaGo; merged with Google Brain in 2023 and now builds Gemini.

orgs.name: Meta AI
orgs.zh: 研究部门 2013 年建立，2023 年起以 Llama 系列成为开放生态的地基。
orgs.en: Research arm since 2013; the Llama series anchors the open ecosystem from 2023.

orgs.name: Mistral AI
orgs.zh: 欧洲的开放权重模型公司，从 Mistral 7B 起家。
orgs.en: Europe's open-weight model company, founded on Mistral 7B.

orgs.name: DeepSeek
orgs.zh: 中国的开放权重模型团队，V3 与 R1 两代都进了第一梯队。
orgs.en: Chinese open-weight team; both V3 and R1 reached the front tier.

orgs.name: xAI
orgs.zh: 马斯克创立，产出 Grok 系列。
orgs.en: Founded by Elon Musk; builds the Grok series.

orgs.name: 月之暗面 Moonshot AI
orgs.zh: Kimi 系列的制造者，长上下文是招牌。
orgs.en: Maker of Kimi; long context is its signature.

orgs.name: 智谱 AI Zhipu
orgs.zh: GLM 系列，中国最早的大模型团队之一。
orgs.en: The GLM series; one of China's earliest large-model teams.

orgs.name: 阿里巴巴 通义千问
orgs.zh: Qwen 开放权重家族，下载量最大的开放模型之一。
orgs.en: The Qwen open-weight family; among the most downloaded open models.

orgs.name: Cohere
orgs.zh: 面向企业的模型与检索工具，重排模型的常用出处。
orgs.en: Enterprise models and retrieval tooling; a common source of rerank models.

orgs.name: Hugging Face
orgs.zh: 模型托管与开放社区，被称为「AI 的 GitHub」。
orgs.en: Model hosting and open community; often called the GitHub of AI.

note.zh: 2021 年斯坦福团队给这个词下了正式定义：在广泛数据上训练、可适配许多下游任务的模型。
note.en: Formally defined by a Stanford team in 2021: models trained on broad data and adaptable to many downstream tasks.

ref: 《On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models》（arXiv）
On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models (arXiv 2108.07258)

note.zh: 2022 年 InstructGPT 让「用人类反馈训练模型听话」成为主流做法。
note.en: InstructGPT made training models to follow human feedback mainstream in 2022.

ref: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155)

note.zh: 模型编出看起来可信的假内容，这个词从研究者黑话变成大众词。
note.en: Models inventing plausible-sounding falsehoods; the term moved from researcher slang to common vocabulary.

ref: International AI Safety Report 2026《Extended Summary for Policymakers》（能力与语境表现章节）
International AI Safety Report 2026, Extended Summary for Policymakers

note.zh: 模型能调用工具之后，「会自己做事的 AI」成了通用词。
note.en: Once models could call tools, "AI that does things by itself" became common vocabulary.

ref: OpenAI 函数调用指南（官方）

note.zh: 先有闭源的长思维链模型，2025 年 DeepSeek-R1 把这套强化学习方法做成了开源。
note.en: Closed long-chain-of-thought models came first; DeepSeek-R1 open-sourced the reinforcement-learning recipe in 2025.

ref: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning (arXiv 2501.12948)
